demos.name: AI Demo Standalone
demos.description: A mock of the AI-DEMO2 dashboard: all 87 use cases in one catalog, run against one mock PDP (token, gateway, policy, then HITL obligations). Foundations, controls, HITL (UC7/8/22) and A2A hand-off (UC2/2.5/2.6/2.7) are wired; the other tracks are listed. Mock only; Real is reserved.
demos.notes: Host-run: ./scripts/run.sh (port 7810). Mock needs no tenant and no credentials. Docker: HOST_PORT=7810 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Catalog id D128.
